ci: Student t, two-sided 95%, across independent seeds
paired_tests: Wilcoxon signed ranks, two-sided, Pratt zeros; Holm correction across all comparisons

input_provenance.warning: Demand and OD are preliminary estimates from earlier observations; not calibrated or validated models from Person 2.
input_provenance.initialization: Last non-spike observation at/before start, max age 15 minutes; otherwise historical mean.
input_provenance.demand: Historical departures / available exposure, station x local hour, observations strictly before scenario day.
input_provenance.od: Historical user OD with one distance-weighted pseudo-observation per origin; inactive destinations excluded.
input_provenance.ride_time: Example lognormal multiplier, sigma=0.4, mean=1; base network distance / 14 km/h.
input_provenance.agent_rules: Example: 65% try a station within 600m; walk 4.5 km/h; soft capacity, no full-station redirect by default.
input_provenance.truck_rules: 20 bikes; loading and unloading 15 seconds/bike; 25 km/h free-flow; congestion is 1-current/free-flow.
input_provenance.operator: Actual observed transfers on selected day, queued by departure, physically executed by finite fleet; late jobs remain late.
input_provenance.interpretation: Operator replay uses that day's observations ex post; this is not a deployable online policy or final evidence for H3.
